metadata.datasource:
This profile was created by processing raw measurement data from data-sheets and/or scientific papers. Original data are property of the respective holders.
    Film/photo-paper: Kodak and Fujifilm data-sheets, scientific publications, and technical material.
    Reflectance: Otsu (https://github.com/enneract/otsu2018), Munsell (https://zenodo.org/records/3269912), human skin (https://www.nist.gov/programs-projects/reflectance-measurements-human-skin), forest colors (https://zenodo.org/records/3269920), Japan colors (https://zenodo.org/records/5217752).
    All data publicly available.
metadata.quality: Black-and-white cine print FILM, not photographic paper. Fixed supplied 5-minute condition; unfiltered printing, no Multigrade grade pack. Upstream digitized data; default print/scanner effects, not an independently calibrated optical printer or grain model.
metadata.conversion: SpektraLab 2026-10-31: condition index 2 (5 min) selected consistently for base, characteristic curve, sublayers and CDF. Silver sensitivity/curve/model/sublayers repeated across three channels; silver dye density divided by three to conserve total optical density. Keep support=film, stage=printing, axes and original five conditions archived. No refit or interpolation.
